name: Darkened Shadow Cannon (4-17)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-17: Trapping the Hag's Claw

disable: DC 24 Arcana check or DC 24 Thievery check to disrupt the cannon; two checks are required to disable it
routine: (three actions) The cannon fires a blast that contains as many PCs as possible, choosing randomly in the event of a tie, then reloads.

items.name: Load the Cannons
items.text:
Trigger The ship flies within 30 feet of a PC

---

Effect The cannon reloads and rolls initiative.

text: A cannon built of cast iron and infused with shadow magic, mounted on the side of Aslynn's flying ship.
